settings.heading: Light, moving shadows and everyday sounds — so from the street, someone is home.
settings.lede: For anyone whose home sits empty during the day, on holiday or between visits: Kevin plays the three signs of life a burglar checks for, from one plug-in device. No camera, no microphone, and it keeps running when Wi-Fi is jammed.
settings.cta_subheading: Buy Kevin outright: free shipping across the EU, 30-day returns, 3-year Swiss warranty.

settings.heading: Burglars check for light, movement and sound. Kevin gives them all three.
settings.body: Every scene plays from the device itself and is visible and audible where it counts: from the pavement, through the curtains, at the front door.

settings.image_alt: Kevin light scene visible through a window
settings.title: Light that behaves like people
settings.body: Warm light shifts the way real lamps and a flickering TV do. Not one lamp on a timer at the same time every night, but a room that looks in use.

settings.image_alt: Moving shadow silhouette projected on a wall behind curtains
settings.title: Shadows that move
settings.body: Patented moving silhouettes cross the wall or ceiling behind your curtains. From outside it reads as one or more people walking through the room.

settings.title: The sounds of a normal evening
settings.body: Conversation, the TV, cooking, a dog that barks when the doorbell rings. 70+ hours of built-in scenes, up to four weeks without repeating, plus your own recordings. Built-in voices are in English, German and Swiss German.

settings.heading: An alarm reacts once the door is tested. Kevin works before anyone tries.
settings.body: Cameras record what already happened and can go dark when Wi-Fi is jammed. Kevin makes the house look occupied from outside, so the attempt never starts. Keep your alarm; put prevention in front of it.

settings.image_alt: Jammed Wi-Fi cameras go dark while Kevin keeps playing from local storage
settings.title: Keeps playing when Wi-Fi is jammed
settings.body: Cheap jamming devices cut cameras and app alarms off the network. Kevin stores every scene on 32 GB inside the device and only uses Wi-Fi or Bluetooth for setup and updates. Light, shadow and sound continue without a signal.

settings.image_alt: Kevin next to an existing alarm panel
settings.title: Works alongside your alarm
settings.body: Alarms and cameras detect. Kevin deters. It is honest about its limits: it will not call anyone or record anything. It makes an empty home look and sound lived-in, which is the layer most security setups are missing.

settings.overline: Made in Switzerland, made for privacy
settings.heading: No camera. No microphone. Nothing streamed.
settings.body: Engineered and designed in Switzerland. Kevin projects light, shadow and sound; it never watches or listens. Plug it in near a window with a wall or ceiling for shadows, pair once, and it is ready. Typical use around 9 watts.

settings.title: Useful when you are home, too
settings.body: Between trips, Kevin works as a Bluetooth speaker and a lamp, so it earns its place by the window all year. Three buttons on the device start the essentials without the app.
